scope.symptom: For each COD record with incomplete collection party identity, _deliveries scanned all shipping contexts to locate a unique compatible context.
scope.implementation: After all shipping obligations and delivery events have supplied their contexts, lazily build one order-to-ordered-contexts index at the first canonical missing-party lookup. Filter that order's contexts with the original equality predicates and retain the original unique-only binding.
scope.lifetime: One _deliveries invocation and its currency only; no process, revision, actor, or request spanning cache.
scope.fallback: Any non-exact-str shipping order disables the index for that invocation. A non-exact-str query order always uses the original full scan, even when a canonical index already exists.
scope.complete_party: No index is prepared when collection identity is already complete, including identity supplied by an existing COD obligation.
invariants: Preserve context insertion order, duplicate fee grouping, unique-versus-ambiguous matching, and existing collections overwrite order.
Preserve all financial amounts, dates, proof fields, row identities, completeness, notes, tables, and output ordering.
Preserve missing and falsey identity semantics without normalization or choosing the first ambiguous candidate.
Keep all source data and report inputs unchanged; keep existing permission, source binding, worker isolation, and deadline behavior.
Check cancellation for each index entry; a cancelled invocation retains no partial shared value.
excluded: No permanent cache, decoded-state sharing, worker lifecycle change, eager cross-view computation, or timeout increase.
No source projection, Mongo index, financial mutation, production resource, billing, or provider change.
No edits to PR #2114, release intent, production branch, shared /app, or browser.
